name: Lose the Heat 3: Highway Hero
storyline: Picking up immediately after the explosive cliffhanger of Lose the Heat 2, the protagonist survives the car bomb planted by the corrupt "Mayor K." (referred to in-game as "Mr. K") and acquires a new heavily modified muscle car. Tracing the kidnapper across five interstate highway stages from Arizona to Washington, D.C., player must outrun relentless state police, dodge missiles fired from attack helicopters and highway overpasses, trigger massive environmental traps, and utilize an allied 18-wheeler support truck to rescue their kidnapped girlfriend.
summary: Lose the Heat 3: Highway Hero is a 3D arcade driving and vehicular combat browser game. Marking a major technical and structural evolution for the series, the game transitioned from the Adobe Shockwave engine to the Unity Web Player and replaced the semi-free-roaming city sandbox of the first two installments with high-speed, cross-country linear highway pursuits across the United States.
